Екрани гри

Екрани сесії у вигляді ui-2.0.0 («Плитка», палітра «Чорнильна мʼята»), зібрані з компонентів і текстів колоди так, як їх збудує Godot: кожен стан — окремий кадр 1920×1080. Готово: 10 з 10.

1 Перший запуск і навчання Tutorial

The tutorial room. On the first launch the invite (the language is chosen only in Settings, s5); in the room, the current lesson at the top and the lesson list at the right, over the MVP round HUD of s7 without the timer, the anger meter, the roster and the role (Hud). After lesson 9 the game returns to the ship (the player's own, no session) with no end screen, where the game boots (the engineer, 2026-10-21). The nine lessons are the game's (GDD §15: Throwing replaced Delivery in #901); which lessons the MVP adds (points and the workbench, the neighbours' anger and the cops, a task) is open, the engineer's design. Lesson 2 names the battery, an MVP item (a draft; which item lies in the room is the game's data).

First launch only (a user:// flag). A quiet tile over the dimmed room; Start the tutorial takes focus with its ring hidden (below), so no control shows focus here.

Lesson 2, its first instruction: a sentence with one keycap.

Lesson 1 (Controls): a row of keycaps instead of the sentence.

Lesson 5, its second instruction: the round «?» keycap inside the sentence. The map (s8) is open in this lesson; it is not drawn here, nor the HUD under its dim.

Lesson 7 (Death): the player died and waits in the dead's room (m8 §3), so the round HUD is hidden; the dead's room overlay is s9's and is not drawn here. Its two lines are drafts.

3 Підключення й завантаження Connecting, failures and loading

One screen on the opaque night backdrop for the join (its steps and each failure in plain words), a session that ended (lost, map failed, error), a host that could not start, and the map loading with the players and a tip or a how-to card. Leaving (left, closed) shows nothing here: straight back to the ship (the game boots into the ship; the suit menu, s5, joins and hosts). Every text is rebuilt on NOTIFICATION_TRANSLATION_CHANGED. Open (the engineer's design): whether loading shows the aliens' flight to Earth (m8 §1). The how-to card holds as many frames as its task needs and scrolls sideways when they do not fit (the engineer, 2026-10-22); its art is a placeholder here (below).

A code join, step FINDING; the host's name is not known yet. CONNECTING looks the same with connect.step.connecting.

A Direct join (LAN or VPN): it starts at CONNECTING, shows no code row and no address.

Step JOINED; the host's lobby name has arrived (#214).

no_room

joins_closed

wrong_version, wrong_content, service_refused, unknown_map; the two version lines when known.

full

service_unreachable

host_unreachable

connect_failed (a Direct join)

host_lost: a running session ended (from the lobby or a round).

load_failed, load_deadline

row_error, own_client_malformed, own_client_disconnected

cannot_host: Host (with a code or directly) could not start.

From the Loading phase until pre game (s6): this machine's progress, the players, one random tip.

As load, with the how-to card of a task type in this round the player has not completed instead of the players and the tip.

4 Лобі Lobby

The ship is the lobby (the target page pages/suit-final, frames 1, 3 and 3b): the game boots into the aliens' ship and the player walks around it; the HUD over the world is thin and calm. The mouse is captured and every HUD node has mouse_filter IGNORE. In a session the HUD is the ready count at the top centre, the roster at the top right (the host mark and a ready pip per player), the own ready state and the mic at the bottom left. Ready toggles on the bound ready key (control.ready, rebindable in Settings › Controls). The countdown starts when everyone is ready and the mode's demands are met; an un-ready stops it. The match settings are no tab of the Esc menu: they are a screen on the ship's console (Console below), a SubViewport scene as the workbench s11 is, shown on the console's mesh to whoever stands near it; the host edits it with the crosshair, everyone else reads it. How the trip maps onto Lobby, Countdown, Loading and Pregame is open (the engineer's design).

The game has just loaded into the ship with no session: no HUD but a small hint at the bottom left (the target's frame 1). Esc opens the suit menu (s5 ship), where the player hosts or joins.

A code joiner's view (Zinga) in a lobby of six: four ready, the own player among them. The two players in sight carry their name plates.

Everyone ready and the mode's demands met: the countdown runs 5, 4, 3, 2, 1 in the same plate, every pip full.

Fewer players than the mode needs: the plate says how many more, instead of the ready count, and its pips hide. The own player not ready.

The host (Olena) at the console (the target's frame 3b): the console's screen, the SubViewport scene Console, drawn at its 960 x 540 where the player looks, with the HUD over the world. The crosshair is on the lower right of the humans' minus, clear of its icon, so the button hovers (pushed mouse motion, as in s11).

Another player (Zinga) reading the console: the same screen without steppers or choices, values only, and the lock line naming the host.

5 Меню Esc Esc menu

The suit menu over the running game (no pause), the left side panel the engineer approved on 2026-10-22 (pages/esc-start: «Yes, the menu on the left as on the page»), like a start menu: Esc (ui_cancel) brings one panel out at the left, full height, and the world stays visible at its right; no tabs and no footer row. The panel holds only what makes sense where the player is: in the ship with no session the own code and Find a lobby, Host, Tutorial, Guide, Settings, Quit; in the lobby the lobby's code and Resume, Character, Guide, Settings, Leave, Quit; in a round Resume, Guide, Settings, Leave, Quit (no Role: the HUD shows the role; no Character: it is changed only in the lobby); in the tutorial Resume, Guide, Settings, Leave the tutorial. An entry with a page opens it in a tile beside the panel. The game runs on; the mouse is free while the menu is open and captured again on close. While it is open the own character takes no gameplay input (it stands still: no move, look, sprint, jump, interact or item use; those keys go to the menu or nowhere); the voice keeps working as set (voice activation, or the Talk key while held). Focus: the frames show the mouse's view with no focus drawn; ship-keys shows the ring keyboard and gamepad focus draws. The host's match settings are the ship console's screen (s4). Open (each a visible placeholder here): the lobbies nearby and the own code need the game's network discovery (prime-game#1316); the Guide's new topics (points, mutations, the neighbours' anger, the cops, the dead's room); every MVP task's card art (the art track's; own-work Delivery frames stand in here).

In the ship with no session, nothing open: the game boots straight here (the engineer, 2026-10-21) and every player returns here when a session ends or they leave it. The approved page's frame 1: the own code with Copy at the top, the entries, Quit apart at the bottom. No control is drawn focused: the frames show the mouse's view (ship-keys shows the focus ring).

Find a lobby open beside the panel (the approved page's frame 2): the lobbies nearby, the code entry with Join by address under it. The code field is empty, so its Join is disabled.

No lobby found on the network nearby: the list says so in one line, with no Join; the code entry as in ship-find.

Six valid characters typed into the code field, so its Join is enabled.

The same frame reached with the keyboard or a gamepad: the code's Join has the focus and draws its focus ring. The one frame that documents the ring; every other frame shows the mouse's view, with no focus drawn.

Join by address pressed: the address entry takes the code entry's place, with the default port under it; Join, or host directly.

In the lobby (a session in the ship, no round yet), nothing open (the approved page's frame 3): the lobby's code with Copy at the top; Resume, Character, Guide, Settings; Leave and Quit apart at the bottom.

In the lobby, Character open: the name and the body colour apply live.

In a round, nothing open: Resume, Guide, Settings; Leave and Quit at the bottom. No head, no Role (the HUD shows the role), no Character (changed only in the lobby).

The host pressed Leave: the confirm dialog (P1) over the menu. Quit opens the same dialog titled esc.game.quit_confirm with Confirm esc.game.quit. A player leaves or quits at once.

In a round, Guide open: every how-to card, the basics from the tutorial and one card per MVP task type; Cooking selected. Its art is a placeholder (own-work Delivery frames) until the art track's cards exist; the card holds as many frames as its task needs and scrolls sideways.

In a round, Settings open (the approved page's frame 4), on Sound and voice; the same page opens from the panel in every place. Voice activation is selected, so the threshold row shows. The language is chosen only here, on Language.

Interact is capturing a key; Talk was rebound to M, so Talk and Map show Same key. The list scrolls.

The window mode.

Large text and reduced motion.

The game language, chosen only here; it applies at once.

The tutorial's menu: Resume, Guide, Settings, and Leave the tutorial at the bottom, back to the ship.

6 Pre game: показ ролі Pre game

The black intro of about 3 s in the silent pre game (#213): it shows when the own side arrives, names it and its goal (and, for a human, the other humans), plays one sound per side, and needs no input. Nobody hears anybody and no text says so. Then the round fades in. No mic, no other HUD while it shows. The target page pages/suit-final, frame 4 (the role reveal, loud), every length x 1.5. Open: how the trip from the spaceship lobby maps onto Countdown, Loading and Pregame.

An alien's intro (the target's frame 4, the mint band).

A human's intro (the target's frame 4b): the danger band and title, and the other humans under the goal with their body colours (humans know each other, decided 2026-10-20).

The round fading in: Night fades from alpha 1 to 0 over 0.4 s (a cut under reduced motion) over the round HUD, s7 at the round's first second.

Твоя роль
Прибулець
Влаштуй найкращу вечірку: виконай усі задачі, поки не скінчився час і не приїхали копи.
Твоя роль
Людина
Ти людина під маскою прибульця. Зіпсуй вечірку: протягни час або розлюти сусідів, щоб приїхали копи.

7 HUD у раунді Round HUD

One HUD for the whole round, the MVP's (the engineer's decisions of 2026-10-20 in docs/ui-decisions.md, the sketch pages/mvp-screens frames 1, 1a, 3 and 4 at 0.75: every sketch length x 1.5). s9 hides and returns the same nodes; s1 and s6 draw them as context. Every node has mouse_filter IGNORE. The top: the time and the anger meter side by side in one ToyPlate row, the own side at the top left, every player at the top right. No points on the HUD (they show only on the mutation workbench, s11). The HUD never shows keys, walking or running, who knocked the player down, who killed whom (the engineer, 2026-10-21), a destination or task progress. HUD edges sit 39 px in (the sketch's 26 x 1.5).

An alien with nothing carried; the crosshair is on an extinguisher within reach; the anger is calm (the siren off).

Fireworks in the hand and a bun on the belt, each with its name tag; the anger rises (the siren on).

A human's view: the danger role tile, the other humans tagged in the roster, a battery in the hand. A teammate's name plate keeps the old dissident mark as a visible placeholder: whether a mark over another human's head is still needed beside the roster's tag is open.

Health at 0.22 (two of ten pips, under the 30 % alarm line: ToyPipAlarm and the danger label) and stamina at 0.18 (two pips).

Decided by the engineer (2026-10-06, the wave-19 question page, q9): what the raiser sees while holding Interact next to a downed player. A thin progress bar under the crosshair in place of the object name, filling at the same rate as the downed player's raise bar (s9 raise); no text.

The anger is full: the neighbours called the cops, and the whole party sees the countdown. The round timer hides while the minute runs (one clock: the engineer, 2026-10-22). Open: how long the minute is.

8 Мапа й задачі (M) Map and tasks

M opens and closes this screen over the running round (press, not hold; rebindable, #211); Tab does nothing here. The mouse is freed while it is open and the player keeps walking: only the mouse look stops. Nothing here is a HUD hint: the map never shows players, items, roles, teammates or done points. The MVP: the five MVP task types, the House's rooms, Delivery's zones gone and the zone highlight kept for the MVP tasks; the pin 42 px and the you-are-here chip clear of it. Every length the old x 1.5, the panels kept inside the frame. Input while it is open: the gameplay actions keep working (move, sprint, jump, interact, talk), so Space, which jumps, must never press a focused «?»: remove Space from ui_accept in the project InputMap (Enter and the gamepad's A still press; jump keeps Space), and when the card was opened with the mouse, closing it releases focus instead of giving it back to the «?». The map's focus moves only with the arrows and the d-pad; the left stick and WASD walk.

The task list beside the map; nothing hovered, nothing focused.

The mouse is over the Cooking row (no look of its own): the map lights that task's zones, the kitchen here (sample data); the zone fills the room under its head.

The same from the keyboard or gamepad: an arrow or the d-pad gave Cooking's «?» focus, which shows its ring and lights the zones as hovering the row does. The only frame of this screen that shows a focus ring.

Cooking's «?» was pressed: its how-to card opens over the map (own-work Delivery frames as a placeholder; the card holds as many frames as its task needs and scrolls sideways); Close, Esc or M closes it.

9 Повалений, мертвий, повернення Downed, dead and respawn

The same HUD as s7: Hud and its nodes are s7's (same names and places); this screen only hides and returns them and adds the downed plates, the dead's room and the protection chip. Aim and the name plates behave as in s7 and are left out here. Every node has mouse_filter IGNORE. Never show who knocked the player down or who killed the player (the engineer, 2026-10-21). The knockdown is kept as decided (GDD §3); spectating left with the MVP: the dead wait in the dead's room (m8 §3; the sketch pages/mvp-screens frame 5 at 0.75, every length x 1.5).

Downed and bleeding out: only the two plates and the mic (off) show; the rest of the HUD hides. As decided, kept.

The give-up key is held: the hold bar fills over 1 s.

Someone is raising the player: the raise progress replaces the bleed-out bar; giving up hides.

Dead (killed, bled out or gave up): the player waits 30 s with the other dead in the dead's room, not watching the living (m8 §3, the sketch's frame 5). The rest of the HUD hides but the mic: the dead hear and talk to each other, the living do not hear them (the engineer, 2026-10-22), so the mic is on with who else is here beside it. Open: where the room is; whether they see the timer and the anger (so no timer here). No killer is shown (the engineer, 2026-10-21). The return shows small at the top (the engineer, 2026-10-22).

Back in the round at a random capsule: the s7 HUD returns with the 3 s protection chip. Stamina returns full: all ten pips lit.

10 Post game: кінець раунду Post game

The outro of about 3 s, one of the three loud moments that end a round (the target page pages/suit-final, section 10): the End phase fades to this screen (0.4 s; a cut under reduced motion), plays one sound for the win and one for the loss (the cops' end with a siren, m8 §6), routes no voice (#213) and returns everyone to the ship after 3 s (#212). Nobody hears anybody and no text says so. No input, so no control and no focus. The loud part is only the band (or, for the cops, the whole screen); the lines under it are quiet text. Open: whether the end reveals who was human, and whether it shows the points (today it names only the winner).

Every task done before the timer and the cops (the target's frame 10a): the accent band.

The timer ran out with the tasks unfinished (frame 10b): the danger band.

The cops' minute ran out (frame 10c), the loudest end: the whole screen in the danger colour, the band the same colour, every line in the danger ink.

11 Мутаційний верстат Mutation workbench

New with the MVP (m8 §4). The workbench is the machine's own screen (the engineer, 2026-10-21/22; the target page pages/suit-final, frames 9a to 9c): this scene is the root of a SubViewport (960 x 540, the target's 640 x 360 x 1.5, with the game's Theme) whose ViewportTexture the machine's screen mesh shows, so whoever stands there sees the same screen. It is no overlay: the mouse stays captured, the player's own HUD (s7) stays over the world, and the player works the screen with the crosshair: the game raycasts the screen mesh and pushes the hit point into the SubViewport as mouse motion and Interact as a left click (SubViewport.push_input), so the control under the crosshair hovers; how the input reaches it is the game's choice. The page draws the 960 x 540 canvas alone, centred in the frame. The flow: walk up and start it, choose a mutation, step into the capsule beside the machine, and it mutates you. Points buy three positive mutations; the points show only here. Walking away leaves the screen to the next player (no Close).

Nobody uses the machine: its name and Start. Interact on Start starts it.

7 points: Quick feet (4) and Spring legs (3) can be bought, Thick skin (9) cannot. The crosshair is on Spring legs' button, so it hovers.

Spring legs chosen: the screen names it and fills its ten pips while the player stands in the capsule (seen from inside on the target page); when they are full the mutation is done and the screen goes back to idle.
